new_value.description: The address the verification code is sent to. Committed verbatim as the user's email and, under an EMAIL identity policy, as preferred_username, so its shape is bounded here before anything is sent. The pattern is the pragmatic local@domain.tld check, not full RFC 5322 - deliverability is proven by the code round-trip. It also rejects CR/LF, which keeps header injection out of the sender.
